other_conditions: Eligibility requires a Bachelor's degree under 10+2+4, 10+2+3, 10+1+4 or pre‑1985 10+2+2 system for M.Sc./M.Tech. programmes
Ph.D. candidates must have at least 60% marks or the specified OGPA thresholds (relaxed to 55%/OGPA 7.0 for SC/ST/PC candidates) in their M.Sc./M.Tech. degree
Applicants must be Indian citizens or domiciled persons as defined in the Constitution of India
Candidates must devote their full time to the approved study and cannot hold any other paid or unpaid appointment
In‑service or departmental candidates must be employed by the ICAR/SAU system and meet specific salary allowance conditions to receive the adjusted scholarship amount
benefits_summary: Monthly scholarship of ₹7,560 for M.Sc. and ₹10,500 for Ph.D., plus an annual contingent grant of ₹6,000 (M.Sc.) or ₹10,000 (Ph.D.) towards study expenses.
documents_required: Crossed Demand Draft for application fee
